svg.desc: The same seven-node tree traversed twice. BFS with a queue visits A, B, C, then D, E, F, G layer by layer; DFS with a stack visits A, B, D, E, then C, F, G.

svg.text: BFS and DFS on the same tree

svg.text: Numbers are the visit order. Only the container differs: a queue or a stack.
